title: Disruptive Launches $10B Fund for Major Investments
excerpt: Disruptive has secured a $10 billion fund with plans to make large-scale investments in a minimum of 10 companies.
body_html:
Disruptive has successfully raised a $10 billion fund with the objective of making major financial investments in at least 10 different companies.

Previously, the firm gained attention for its significant investments in prominent startups, including AI voice-generation company ElevenLabs and chip startup Groq.
